full_name: Faren Humes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Arts Radcliffe-Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Artist
bio: Faren Humes is a filmmaker from Miami and Sanderson, Florida, who melds narrative and documentary conventions to explore and invoke Black continuation.
